castSkill-actor.label: Actor
castSkill-actor.tip: Cast a skill of this actor. The skill caster can be read in the skill event.

by-key.name: By Shortcut Key
by-key.tip: Get the actor's skill by a shortcut key

by-id.name: By Skill ID
by-id.tip: Get the actor's skill by skill ID

by-skill.name: By Skill Instance
by-skill.tip: Get the skill object by the skill accessor (It must be in this actor's skill list to take effect)

by-variable.name: By Variable
by-variable.tip: Get the shortcut key name from a variable

castSkill-key.label: Shortcut Key
castSkill-key.tip: Get the skill registered with this shortcut key from the skill list

castSkill-keyVar.label: Shortcut Key Variable
castSkill-keyVar.tip: Enter a shortcut key name (e.g. Attack, Skill1) or use a variable getter

castSkill-skillId.label: Skill
castSkill-skillId.tip: Get the skill whose skill ID matches from the skill list

castSkill-skill.label: Skill
castSkill-skill.tip: Get the skill from the skill accessor
